ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is a food web. It includes labeled organisms and roles such as Sun, Leaves-Producer, Beetle-Secondary Consumer/Omnivore, Tadpole-Secondary consumer/Omnivore, Minnow-Secondary consumer/Omnivore, Shrimp-Secondary consumers/Omnivore, Worm-Decomposer, Dog-Primary consumer/Carnivore, Fox-Primary consumer/Carnivore, Platypus-Primary consumer/Carnivore, Humans-Tertiary consumer/Omnivore, and Eagle-Primary consumer/Carnivore. The arrows connect organisms to show feeding or energy-flow relationships in the web. Reasoning: The question asks which organism has no natural predators. In this food web, arrows indicate energy moving from the organism being eaten toward the consumer or predator. To find an organism with no natural predators, I look for the top predator that is not shown as food for another animal. The eagle is shown as a carnivore/top predator, and there is no arrow showing another animal preying on the eagle. Therefore, the organism with no natural predators is the eagle.
